purpose: Runtime-neutral semantic assertion contract for Cinema and Series validation cases.

identity_scopes.exact_entity: Two or more references resolve to the same durable CAS entity.
identity_scopes.underlying_work: References may be different CAS entity kinds, but resolve to the same underlying creative Work.
identity_scopes.series_lineage: References participate in the same program/franchise lineage without asserting exact entity identity.

same_identity.notes: identity_scope is mandatory. Optional subject_refs/object_refs extend the assertion to a set; all bound refs must match at the requested scope.

different_identity.notes: Optional subject_refs/object_refs extend the assertion to a set; every bound ref must have a distinct exact identity key.

has_relationship.notes: Optional subject_refs/object_refs are evaluated as the Cartesian product of all bound subjects and objects.

does_not_have_relationship.notes: Optional subject_refs/object_refs are evaluated as the Cartesian product of all bound subjects and objects.

has_value.notes: Optional subject_refs require the field to exist for every bound subject.

does_not_overwrite.notes: Optional subject_refs require the non-overwrite guard for every bound subject.

preserves_claims.notes: Optional subject_refs require a preserved multi-claim set for every bound subject.

supports_multiple.notes: Optional subject_refs require multiplicity support for every bound subject.

rules: A semantic engine must never convert NOT_IMPLEMENTED into PASS.
Missing bindings are validation debt, not a passing result.
same_identity without an explicit identity_scope is not runtime-ready.
A Version and its parent Work are different CAS entities even when identity_scope=underlying_work evaluates true.
subject_refs and object_refs are additive to their singular counterparts and must never be used to hide an unbound required singular reference.
Set-aware identity assertions evaluate every bound entity, not only the first pair.
Set-aware relationship assertions evaluate every required subject-object pair.
custom assertions require an explicitly named specialized evaluator before they can pass automatically.
Engine results must identify the assertion_id and observed state used to reach the result.
